messages:
Ibrahim: Starting a slow roll for v2026-04-02 -> canary 5% eu-west-1 now per change window. tagging release-notes with basics.
Claire: Noted. I'll watch latency and error budget dashboards. Planning to hold 10m after cutover for tail signals.
Ravi: Heads up, model shard compacting job also kicked at T-2m. If we see cache churn that might be related.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout initiated: selector=canary:v2026-04-02 percent=5 region=eu-west-1 id=roll-9812
ops-bot: ALERT: p95 increased from 110ms -> 320ms on canary shard set at 3m post-cutover. 5xx stable.
Claire: Saw that. Pulling traces now. Any host-level anomalies?
Ibrahim: Nothing scheduled on infra side. Ravi, can your compacting job cause KV churn?
Ravi: It can increase background compaction IO and KV eviction slightly. But the magnitude seems larger than expected.
Claire: Traces show a single host eu1-host-17 with repeated >200ms syscalls. Could be local IO pressure.
Ibrahim: Let's apply routing override to exclude eu1-host-17 from canary and extend hold. If metrics recover we continue. If not, we rollback to v2026-03-29. Agreed?
Ravi: Agreed. Prefer override first to avoid losing canary telemetry.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: action request: route-override apply --selector canary:v2026-04-02 --exclude-hosts eu1-host-17 --until 1798128000 --reason "noisy-host-io"
deploy-bot: status: job rchg-9819 started
ops-bot: INFO: rchg-9819 progress: 2/3 successes, 1 retry
Claire: One instance hit a socket timeout applying the patch, retrying now.
deploy-bot: status: rchg-9819 completed at 1798123510: 3/3 success
Claire: p95 back to ~125ms. KV eviction normalized. No change in 5xx.
Ibrahim: Good. Extend canary observation by 25m and annotate release notes: "Extended canary hold due to transient eu1-host IO pressure; routing override applied; no rollback."
Ravi: I'll throttle compaction retry backoff to reduce IO while we observe. Also opening INC-7412 to reprovision eu1-host-17.
Ibrahim: Thanks. If we see a reoccurrence within the extended window, we'll pin the canary to eu-west-2 and re-evaluate rollback. For now, resume slow ramp after 25m quiet.
Claire: Monitoring dashboards + traces. Will post if anything changes.
ops-bot: NOTE: canary hold extended until 1798125300 per change update.
Ibrahim: Closing this thread for now. Reopen if we need to roll back or pin region. :thumbsup:
